principles: use three substantive lessons per unit with lesson-3 independent production or mediation
strengthen concrete B1 reception, interaction, short connected narration and practical reformulation
recycle reported information, sequencing, reasons, realistic conditions, polite requests and negotiation
keep tasks within familiar real-world domains and avoid B2 counterfactuals, dense concession, inferential calibration, multi-source synthesis and sustained abstract argumentation
keep Persian support concise, natural and action-oriented
